memory_update.text: POWL should be tracked as a high-priority underfollowed-to-mainstream transition candidate for medium-voltage distribution and switchgear exposure; its fiscal 2026 backlog and data-center commentary are strong Layer 1B evidence.

BELFB is a niche magnetics/power-electronics candidate rather than a utility transformer pure play; survival to later layers depends on proving material revenue exposure to data centers, power conversion, industrial electrification, or e-mobility.

PPSI remains a speculative-shadow micro-cap exception; current switchgear/critical-power exposure is plausible, but historic transformer exposure was reduced by the 2019 sale of Pioneer Transformers and the dry-type transformer group.

US-listed pure-play transformer manufacturers are scarce; the investable node likely maps through adjacent medium-voltage switchgear, facility power distribution, dry-type transformer lines inside larger electrical companies, and component-level magnetics.

node: Transformers, dry-type transformers, magnetics, power conditioning, and medium-voltage distribution equipment
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around transformer-adjacent power distribution and magnetics. The two-lane funnel keeps Eaton as a high-attention reference leader, while the underfollowed lane highlights Powell Industries and Bel Fuse as more focused public-market mappings, plus Pioneer Power Solutions as a micro-cap speculative exception. The strongest direct evidence is for medium-voltage switchgear, dry-type transformers, magnetics, and facility/grid power distribution equipment. Transformer manufacturing pure plays remain scarce in US-listed equities, so several candidates are adjacent to the chokepoint rather than pure transformer manufacturers.
